raw_prompt:
用GPT Image 2.5幫我畫3格靜態分鏡圖，延續這個對話裡魯魯已經建立好的外觀（不要戴皇冠/披風，就是一般魯魯，維持角色一致性）。題材：「過度隆重的一顆飼料」——魯魯穿正式小西裝，在一張正式餐桌前，桌上有銀色餐罩、燭台、摺好的餐巾，排場非常隆重。

第1格：全套正式排場擺好，魯魯坐在餐桌前，表情一本正經，銀罩蓋著還沒掀開。
第2格：魯魯一隻爪伸出去，正要掀開銀罩，動作優雅慎重，像在進行重要儀式。
第3格：銀罩掀開，餐盤裡只有一顆飼料，魯魯表情依然完全嚴肅沒有任何搞笑表情，形成反差。

不要在圖片裡加任何文字或對話框，畫面本身要讓人一眼看懂在幹嘛跟哪裡好笑。3張圖風格、場景、燈光要一致，構圖比例16:9。

I'm using Grok Imagine to generate a short 6-second video of a tiny cat acting as a makeup artist, applying eyeshadow to a person's closed eyelid with a brush. I want the eyelid to visibly transform from bare skin at the start to fully covered in shimmering eyeshadow by the end — a clean, monotonic, one-directional progression, not oscillating or reverting partway through. My text-only prompts keep producing inconsistent results (color appears then partially disappears then reappears). What's the best technique in Grok Imagine specifically to reliably control a start-state and end-state transformation like this? Should I generate a "before" image and an "after" image myself first (and if so, should I generate both using Grok Imagine itself rather than a different image tool, to avoid style/character drift), then use some kind of first-frame/last-frame or image-to-video anchoring feature? Does Grok Imagine actually support that kind of keyframe control? Please give me concrete, tool-specific guidance, not generic AI video advice.

Extreme close-up macro photo of one closed human eyelid, bare natural skin tone, no makeup, no eyeshadow, eyelashes visible, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field. A tiny cream-white British Shorthair kitten (round face, blue-grey eyes, pink nose) sits on the eyelid holding a small makeup brush, tip just touching the bare lid, about to apply eyeshadow. An open pink compact case with shimmering pink eyeshadow powder sits beside the kitten. Photorealistic, 9:16 vertical.

Edit this exact image. Keep the identity, pose, camera crop, lighting, background, and the kitten's body position completely unchanged. Change only the closed eyelid: it should now be fully covered in dense shimmering pink eyeshadow, pigment built up evenly to the crease, visible sparkle across the whole lid. Move the brush slightly to the far end of the stroke as if the last pass just finished. Do not open the eye. Do not change anything outside the eyelid.
這兩張構圖太緊，眉毛完全沒入鏡，看起來很怪。麻煩兩張都用同一個稍微拉遠一點的裁切重新出，要能看到一點眉毛，其他（魯魯、眼影顏色、盒子位置）都不要變。
